spans.s: --the hump-backed Kubja in the employ of Kamsa for preparing perfumes. कृष्ण got some for the mere asking. Pleased, कृष्ण cured her deformity and made her a lovely damsel. She requested कृष्ण to go to her residence, which he promised to do sometime later. Vi. V. २०. 4-१३.
--born of Nila; belong to a branch of the आलम्बेयस्; invincible and bold. वा. ६९. १७९.
